notes.V: DERIVED Oppenheim convention V = r_N^2 * Delta x (nuclear size in y,z; delocalization in x). The smearing-length vs wavepacket-volume choice can move the continuous and non-local lower bounds by many orders; the discrete lower bound M/lambda does not depend on V.
notes.FOM: CITED Janse: FOM_D2 = sigma_a^2 N Delta T = S_a N, units m^2 s^{-3}.
notes.Table1_vs_formula: Plugging the stated Cavendish FOM into Eqs. (46)–(47) gives uppers ~2 orders weaker (larger) than the rounded Table 1 values. We use the formulas as DERIVED and quote Table 1 / Janse rounded windows as CITED.

projections.citation: Kaltenbaek, arXiv:1508.07796; MAQRO M4 proposal (~1e10 amu, ~100 s)
projections.caveat: MAQRO aims at several 10^10 amu and ~100 s coherence in space. Year 2035 is a placeholder, not a launch date. N~2.5e9 assumes ~12 u constituents. If demonstrated, this would close both remaining 2023-model windows from below even against the conservative Gisler-level upper bound.

projections.citation: Janse et al., Phys. Rev. Research 6, 033076 (2024), Sec. III; Fuchs 2024; Angeli et al., arXiv:2501.13030
projections.caveat: ASSUMED FOM = Gisler/1e4 (four more orders from vibration isolation toward the thermal floor of a mK magnetic-levitation / SQUID torsion-like sensor). Janse argue FOM ~ 4 N kT omega / (m Q); lowering m does not help, but T, omega, Q do. Angeli et al. 2025 propose a related mK torsion test of LOCC-gravity diffusion (a different but neighbouring bound).

janse2024.citation: Janse, Uitenbroek, van Everdingen, Plugge, Hensen, Oosterkamp, Phys. Rev. Research 6, 033076 (2024), arXiv:2403.08912
janse2024.role: Tightens the upper side of the 2023 Newtonian D2 window by compiling low force-noise experiments. Conservative (absolute, on Earth) improvement of at least 15 orders of FOM relative to Cavendish. Aggressive inclusion of Asenbaum 2017 would drop below the discrete lower bound and leave ~1 order (on the 2011 floor) for the non-local model, but those points are differential.

layton2023_2024.citation: Layton, Oppenheim, Russo, Weller-Davies, JHEP 08, 163 (2023); Layton, Oppenheim, Weller-Davies, Quantum 8, 1565 (2024)
layton2023_2024.role: Theory of the weak-field / 'healthier' semi-classical CQ dynamics. No new experimental D2 number.

grudka2024.citation: Grudka, Morris, Oppenheim, Russo, Sajjad, arXiv:2402.17844 (2024)
grudka2024.role: Formal renormalisability of pure postquantum-classical gravity via a quadratic-gravity path integral. Relativistic corrections alter the gravitational two-point function and give milder stochastic acceleration fluctuations than a naive Newtonian extrapolation. They argue current upper and lower bounds are already tight enough that tabletop tests of the quantum vs classical nature of spacetime may be possible in the near term — a caveat on the Newtonian D2 mapping used in this tracker.

angeli2025.citation: Angeli, Donadi, Di Bartolomeo, Gaona-Reyes, Vinante, Bassi, arXiv:2501.13030 (2025)
angeli2025.role: If gravity is an LOCC channel it must inject a minimum diffusion into the motion of quantum systems. They propose a millikelvin torsion-pendulum protocol to look for that diffusion without preparing a macroscopic superposition. Related in spirit to the upper side of the tradeoff, but the bound is setup-dependent and is not the same parameter as Oppenheim's D2.

oppenheim_sajjad2026.role: Linearised relativistic theory: dimensionless diffusion constants for scalar and tensor channels. Matter-wave floor still quoted as D ≳ 10^{-71} from the 2011 molecular-superposition analysis; LVK tensor ceiling D ≲ 3.3e-67; window 10^{-71} ≲ D_{2,tensor} ≲ 10^{-67} (~4.5 orders). Full-positivity scalar ceiling D ≲ 1.3e-66 (~5.1 orders). LISA Pathfinder constrains the scalar channel under transverse positivity only. These are dimensionless couplings of the relativistic theory, not the dimensionful Newtonian D2 of Table 1; we report them separately and do not mix units.

carney2026.role: Classification of non-quantized, Galilei-invariant Newtonian models. Any non-entangling model must inject a quantifiable minimal noise; measuring below that threshold would be equivalent to showing that Newtonian gravity is entangling. Does not directly replace the 2023 D2 windows.

bild2023_not_used.role: 16 µg mechanical-oscillator cat, decoherence ~1 MHz (Janse). A phonon cat is not a centre-of-mass mass-density superposition of the kind entering Oppenheim's M/lambda bound, so we do not promote it to a D2 floor.

wang2021_not_used.role: Hour-scale ion-qubit coherence is a spin superposition, not a mass-density superposition (Janse correctly set it aside).

verdict_one_liner: The ultra-local continuous model is ruled out (Oppenheim 2023 Table 1: upper 10^{-41} < lower 10^{-9} kg^2 s m^{-3}) and stays ruled out. The ultra-local discrete window, using formula bounds, Pedalino 2025 for the floor and Gisler 2022 for a conservative absolute ceiling, is still open by about 10 orders of magnitude; Janse's rounded conservative window was 9 orders on the 2011 floor. The non-local / Diosi-Penrose-like window is much tighter: about 3–4 orders remain conservatively (Pedalino floor vs Gisler ceiling). Including Asenbaum 2017 as if it were an absolute acceleration measurement would already close both remaining windows, but that point is differential and its applicability is questioned (Janse 2024). A 10^6 amu, 0.1 s interferometer would essentially close the non-local conservative window from below; closing the discrete conservative window from below wants MAQRO-scale mass and time (several 10^{10} amu, ~100 s), or a ~10-order improvement in an absolute FOM. The 2026 Oppenheim–Sajjad dimensionless relativistic window is a separate accounting (~4.5 orders on the tensor channel) and still uses the 2011 matter-wave floor.
